title: Bring back the customer index on orders; add orders.channel
author: dev-arjun
head: db/orders-index-channel
body:
Fixes #102 by indexing `orders.customer_id` again.

While touching the table this also adds the `channel` column that marketing asked for (web / app / phone); the application will start writing it in the next release.

Plan: run in the normal deploy window (weekdays 14:00), rolling deploy as usual.
